records.jp: ねえ、愛央。愛央は放課後とか、<CR>普段どういうことしてた？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao. What did you do after classes usually?
records.en: Hey, Ao. What did you do after classes usually?

records.jp: え、何？　突然……
records.en_original: Wh-what? That was sudden...
records.en: Wh-what? That was sudden...

records.jp: いいじゃん、教えてよ
records.en_original: Aw come on, just tell me.
records.en: Aw come on, just tell me.

records.jp: そうだなぁ……。<CR>駅前に出かけたり、たまにカラオケ行ったり……
records.en_original: Let's see... I guess I mostly just hung around the station or went to karaoke.
records.en: Let's see... I guess I mostly just hung around the station or went to karaoke.

records.jp: 別に、特別なことは何もしてないよ
records.en_original: Nothing special.
records.en: Nothing special.

records.jp: ふむふむ、なるほど……
records.en_original: Hmm... Yes, yes, I see...
records.en: Hmm... Yes, yes, I see...

records.jp: さっきからどうしたの？　ニヤニヤして……
records.en_original: What is with you? You've been grinning creepily this whole time.
records.en: What is with you? You've been grinning creepily this whole time.

records.jp: あたし、そういうのやったことないからさ
records.en_original: It's 'cause I never got to do any of that stuff.
records.en: It's 'cause I never got to do any of that stuff.

records.jp: ずっと憧れてたんだよね。<CR>そういう、学生っぽい遊びとか
records.en_original: I always wanted to do the things that students got to do.
records.en: I always wanted to do the things that students got to do.

records.jp: そっか、ずっと病院で……
records.en_original: Oh right, you were stuck in the hospital...
records.en: Oh right, you were stuck in the hospital...

records.jp: ……ねえ、愛央。<CR>あたしも、普通の学生みたいなこと、できるかな
records.en_original: ...Ao? Do you think I'll be able to do that stuff?
records.en: ...Ao? Do you think I'll be able to do that stuff?

records.jp: あたしも友達と一緒に駅前に出かけたり、<CR>カラオケに行ったり……できるようになるのかな
records.en_original: Hanging around the station with friends... Going to karaoke...
records.en: Hanging around the station with friends... Going to karaoke...

records.jp: ……なるよ。きっとなる
records.en_original: I know you will.
records.en: I know you will.

records.jp: あたし、何にも分かんないからさ……<CR>愛央、あたしのことカラオケに連れてってくれる？
records.en_original: I don't really know many songs though... Will you take me sometime?
records.en: I don't really know many songs though... Will you take me sometime?

records.jp: うん、もちろん
records.en_original: Of course.
records.en: Of course.

records.jp: あー、でも……<CR>その役割は伶那さんに譲ろうかな？
records.en_original: Ah, but... Maybe you'd rather go with Rena?
records.en: Ah, but... Maybe you'd rather go with Rena?

records.jp: 二人で行ってきなよ。<CR>私は……その後でいいからさ
records.en_original: I think you'd have a lot more fun just the two of you. I'll join you another time.
records.en: I think you'd have a lot more fun just the two of you. I'll join you another time.

records.jp: あっ……う、うん
records.en_original: Ah... Uh, yeah.
records.en: Ah... Uh, yeah.

records.jp: ……きっと、これはチャンスなんだ
records.en_original: ...I think this is my chance.
records.en: ...I think this is my chance.

records.jp: 絶対に掴めなかったはずの希望が今、目の前にある
records.en_original: For the first time in my life, what I've always hoped for is right in front of me.
records.en: For the first time in my life, what I've always hoped for is right in front of me.

records.jp: あたし、このチャンスは絶対に逃したくない
records.en_original: I don't want to let this go.
records.en: I don't want to let this go.

records.jp: 生きて、生き抜いて……<CR>全力で、人生を謳歌してやるんだ
records.en_original: I'm going to live with everything I've got.
records.en: I'm going to live with everything I've got.

records.jp: それに――今度は逃げも隠れもせず、<CR>正面から伶那の想いを受け止めてあげられる
records.en_original: And this time... I want to accept Rena's feelings without running away or hiding.
records.en: And this time... I want to accept Rena's feelings without running away or hiding.

records.jp: 伶那は、あたしがいないとダメなんだから
records.en_original: She's hopeless without me.
records.en: She's hopeless without me.

records.jp: 勇希も伶那さんがいないとダメでしょ？
records.en_original: And you without her, right?
records.en: And you without her, right?

records.jp: は、はぁ？　そんなわけないし
records.en_original: Wh-what? I have no idea what you're talking about.
records.en: Wh-what? I have no idea what you're talking about.

records.jp: 本当～？
records.en_original: Oh reeeally?
records.en: Oh reeeally?

records.jp: う、うるさい！　本当だし！
records.en_original: Sh-shut up... It's true!
records.en: Sh-shut up... It's true!

records.jp: …………いや、<CR>こんなところで強がっても愛央にはバレバレか
records.en_original: I guess there's no use acting tough around you. You always see right through me...
records.en: I guess there's no use acting tough around you. You always see right through me...

records.jp: そゆこと
records.en_original: You bet I do.
records.en: You bet I do.

records.jp: …………正直に言うと、怖いよ
records.en_original: To be honest....I'm scared.
records.en: To be honest....I'm scared.

records.jp: こうやって、伶那への想いが強くなるほど……<CR>不安も大きくなってくる<CR>
records.en_original: The stronger my feelings are for Rena, the more I start to worry...
records.en: The stronger my feelings are for Rena, the more I start to worry...

records.jp: 本当にあたしも、再構築後の世界にいられるのかな？
records.en_original: Can I even exist in the rebuilt world?
records.en: Can I even exist in the rebuilt world?

records.jp: あたしだけ、仲間外れに、ならないかな……？
records.en_original: Will I be the only one left out?
records.en: Will I be the only one left out?

records.jp: ならないよ
records.en_original: Of course not.
records.en: Of course not.

records.jp: ならない。絶対に大丈夫
records.en_original: Everything's gonna be okay.
records.en: Everything's gonna be okay.

records.jp: みんなが勇希のことを想ってるんだ
records.en_original: Everyone is thinking about you.
records.en: Everyone is thinking about you.

records.jp: 私たちの想いが世界を形作るんだったら、<CR>そこに勇希がいないわけない
records.en_original: And the world will be built from our thoughts and feelings, so of course you'll be there.
records.en: And the world will be built from our thoughts and feelings, so of course you'll be there.

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: 私たちの想いが、<CR>神様なんかに負けてたまるか！　ってね
records.en_original: God is no match for all our feelings! Just wait and see.
records.en: God is no match for all our feelings! Just wait and see.

records.jp: …………うん。ありがと、愛央
records.en_original: ...Yeah. Thanks, Ao.
records.en: ...Yeah. Thanks, Ao.

records.jp: みんながあたしを、連れていってくれる。<CR>ならもう、信じるだけだ
records.en_original: I believe you'll all bring me with you.
records.en: I believe you'll all bring me with you.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en: I miss you.

records.jp: 愛央に会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I miss you, Ao.

records.jp: あたしは、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
